title: 应用文任务分析
goal: 能确定写作者、读者和目的，并核对内容要求。

points.label: 提取身份、对象与写作目的
判断成文是否回应全部要求

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 应用文任务分析的内容与知识点

body.p: 应用文任务的情境交代写作者、读者和目的。内容要点规定正文需要完成的事项。已给背景帮助理解任务，正文仍要写出要点规定的内容。

body.box:
假定李华是校园电影社成员，社团将举办电影配音活动，请给外教 Ms. Green 写信。
• Invite her to the activity.
• Give the time and place.
• Ask her to reply by Friday.

body.p: 李华是写作者，Ms. Green 是读者，目的是邀请她参加活动。正文还需交代时间和地点，并请求周五前回复。

cards.title: 解题步骤
cards.note: 以上为本课程的建议，不是官方规定。

steps.d: 从情境确定写作者和读者。电影配音任务中，Li Hua 写给 Ms. Green。
确定写信要完成的交际目的。电影社举办活动是背景，邀请 Ms. Green 参加是目的。
逐条找出正文中对应的句子。The activity is at 3 p.m. in Room 4 交代了时间和地点，还需核对邀请和回复要求。

cards.title: 情境与要求
rows: 邀请
假定李华是戏剧社成员，给外教写信。
Invite the teacher; give the rehearsal time.
咨询
假定李华准备报名，给课程办公室写信。
Ask about the fee; ask who may join.
通知
假定李华是学生会成员，面向全校学生发布通知。
Give the collection point; state the deadline.
身份与对象
假定李华代表班级写给图书馆工作人员。
Li Hua writes on behalf of the class to the library staff.

body.box:
假定李华准备参加摄影课程，给课程办公室写信。
• Ask about the course fee.
• Ask when registration closes.
Draft: Could you tell me the course fee? Thank you for your time.

Which requirement is missing?
1. Asking about the course fee.
2. Asking when registration closes.
3. Identifying the course office.
4. Thanking the course office.

body.p: 草稿用 course fee 问了费用，没有问报名截止时间，答案是第二项。结尾的感谢不能代替这一要求。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 遗漏要点
Please join the film activity. It starts at three.
有邀请和时间，缺少地点及回复要求。
对象错误
Dear Film Club Members,
任务要求写给外教，称呼改成了社团成员。
目的不明
Our film club meets every Friday.
只介绍社团，未向外教发出邀请。
背景代替要求
I plan to take the photography course.
报名计划是背景，还需询问费用和截止时间。

groups.text:
假定李华代表班级给自然博物馆工作人员写信，咨询团体参观。
• Ask about available dates.
• Ask about the group fee.

options: The museum staff.
The class members.
The museum visitors.
The class teacher.
items.why: 情境指定写给自然博物馆工作人员，第一项是读者。

options: We would like to visit the museum as a class.
Could you tell us the dates and the group fee?
We know the group fee and will choose a date.
Could you tell us the date of the last visit?
items.why: 要点要求询问可选日期和团体费用，第二项同时提出两项询问。

groups.text:
假定李华是学生会成员，面向本校学生发布旧书交换活动通知。
• Give the exchange location.
• State what books students may bring.

items.stem: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To ask students what old books they have.
To thank students for bringing old books.
To inform students about a book exchange.
To report on a finished book exchange.
items.why: 情境要求面向学生发布旧书交换活动通知，第三项概括了目的。

items.stem: What does the draft omit? Draft: Bring novels or dictionaries to the exchange.
options: The kinds of books accepted.
The activity being announced.
The people who may bring books.
The place for the exchange.
items.why: 草稿说明了可带的书，但没有给出 exchange location，第四项是遗漏的信息。

groups.text:
假定李华是合唱团成员，请给音乐教师 Mr. Brown 写信邀请他观看演出。
• Invite Mr. Brown to the concert.
• Give the concert date and venue.
• Ask him to reply by Monday.
Draft: Dear Mr. Brown, Our choir will perform in the school hall on June 12. Please let me know by Monday. Yours, Li Hua

items.stem: Which action expresses the stated purpose?
options: Inviting Mr. Brown to attend the concert.
Telling Mr. Brown where the choir will sing.
Asking Mr. Brown to reply by Monday.
Thanking Mr. Brown for his earlier reply.
items.why: 情境要求写信邀请 Mr. Brown 观看演出，第一项就是这一目的。第二项的演出地点只是要点之一。

items.stem: Which requirement is absent from the draft?
options: The date and the concert venue.
An invitation to attend the concert.
The requested date for a reply.
The name of the music teacher.
items.why: 草稿给出日期、地点和回复期限，但未邀请 Mr. Brown 参加，第二项是缺项。

groups.text:
假定李华是园艺社成员，写信邀请交换生 Emma 参加种植活动。
• Invite Emma to plant herbs.
• Give the activity time and place.
• Ask Emma to reply by Wednesday.
Draft: Dear Emma, Our club will plant herbs at 4 p.m. in the school garden. Please reply by Wednesday. Best, Li Hua

items.stem: Who is the letter addressed to?
options: Emma, the exchange student.
Li Hua, the club member.
The gardening club members.
The school garden staff.
items.why: 情境指定邀请交换生 Emma，Dear Emma 也表明她是收件人。

items.stem: Which requirement does the draft leave out?
options: The time and place of planting.
The invitation to join the planting.
The deadline for Emma's reply.
The name of the school garden.
items.why: 草稿说明种植安排和回复期限，缺少邀请 Emma 参加的句子。

groups.text:
假定李华准备报名参加陶艺课程，给课程办公室写信咨询。
• Ask about the course fee.
• Ask whether materials are provided.
Draft: Dear Course Office, Could you tell me whether materials are provided? I hope to register soon. Yours, Li Hua

items.stem: What is the main purpose of the letter?
options: To confirm a pottery course registration.
To provide materials for the course.
To request information about the course.
To thank the office for its materials.
items.why: 情境要求咨询陶艺课程，第三项概括了询问信息的目的。

items.stem: Which requirement still needs a sentence?
options: Whether the office provides materials.
Whether the course is about pottery.
Whether Li Hua plans to register.
What fee the course charges.
items.why: 草稿询问了材料是否提供，还需询问 course fee，第四项对应缺少的要求。

items.stem: A student writes to invite a teacher to a school concert.
items.why: would like to invite 表达写信目的，invite 后接受邀对象和活动。

items.stem: A notice must give the time of a school recycling collection.
items.why: will begin 构成谓语，at nine 和 on Saturday 交代时间。

items.stem: A student asks a museum office about the group fee.
items.why: Could you tell me 引出询问，the group fee 指定所需信息。

items.stem: A letter must ask a classmate to reply before Friday.
items.why: let me know 提出回复请求，by this Friday 写明期限。
